description:
Lawachara National Park is one of the most beautiful forests in Bangladesh. In this video, I fly my DJI Mavic 3 Classic over the green forest of Lawachara and show you its natural beauty from above.
Lawachara is located in Sreemangal, Sylhet. It is home to rare wildlife and thousands of trees. From the sky, it looks like a green ocean. 🌿
I hope this video makes you want to visit this amazing place.
📍 Location: Lawachara National Park, Kamalganj, Bangladesh
📷 Camera: DJI Mavic 3 Classic
🌐 Website: asadsnapper.com
